mapper.select: WITH paging_data AS ( SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id , sys01_company_nm AS company_name , emp01_kor_nm AS kor_name , emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'pos_nm') AS pos_name , emp01_office_telno AS office_telno , emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sys01_company_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC, emp01_kor_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC) AS row_num FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm, emp01_kor_nm, emp01_office_telno, emp01_mobile_telno, emp02_note_admin)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND emp01_company_id = COALESCE(#{companyId}, emp01_company_id) AND emp01_person_id IN #{id} ) SELECT person_id, company_name, kor_name, emp_no, pos_name, office_telno, mobile_telno FROM paging_data WHERE row_num > #{offset} ORDER BY row_num LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT count(*) FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm, emp01_kor_nm, emp01_office_telno, emp01_mobile_telno, emp02_note_admin)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND emp01_company_id = COALESCE(#{companyId}, emp01_company_id) AND emp01_person_id IN #{id}

SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id , emp01_kor_nm AS kor_name , emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , sys01_loc_nm AS company_code FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE emp01_person_id IN #{id}
